description: Saving minutes content: version check, sanitising and editor permission.

preconditions: Draft revision with content and UpdatedAt T.
Actor is the current Secretary who manages the meeting; the caller read the revision at T.
cases.inputs:
minutesId: the Draft revision; actor: the current Secretary; content: "

Biên bản họp quý 3.

"; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Content stored as the filtered HTML; UpdatedAt moves to now; 200 MSG396.
cases.log: Saved: content and UpdatedAt on the Draft revision.

preconditions: Revision Rejected with a reason and UpdatedAt T.
Actor is the current Secretary; the caller read the revision at T.
cases.inputs:
minutesId: the Rejected revision; actor: the current Secretary; content: "

Bổ sung kết luận.

"; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Content stored; a returned revision is corrected and can be sent again; 200 MSG396.
cases.log: Saved: content and UpdatedAt on the Rejected revision.

preconditions: Actor's account is deactivated.
cases.inputs:
minutesId: a Draft revision; actor: deactivated Secretary; content: "

A.

"; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure Inactive; 403 with no message code; nothing saved.

preconditions: No revision has the given id.
Actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs:
minutesId: unknown; actor: the current Secretary; content: "

A.

"; loadedAt: now.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 with no message code; nothing saved.

preconditions: Draft revision exists.

"; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 with no message code; nothing saved and nothing revealed.

preconditions: Revision WaitingApproval with UpdatedAt T.
Actor is the current Secretary.

minutesId: the waiting revision; actor: the current Secretary; content: "

A.

"; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure Locked; 409 MSG400; a sent revision is no longer edited here.

preconditions: Draft revision; actor is the current Secretary; the caller read it at T.
cases.inputs:
minutesId: the Draft revision; content: "

" (no text after filtering); loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure Invalid; 400 MSG402; errors[content] = ["Nhập nội dung biên bản, tối đa 300.000 ký tự."]; nothing saved.
cases.note: UC-60 · MSG402 · Deviation: Deviation: failure=Invalid (Invalid holds, MSG402 holds, nothing saved), but errors.content is 'Nhập nội dung biên bản, tối đa 300,000 ký tự.' not the UTC-quoted 'Nhập nội dung biên bản, tối đa 300.000 ký tự.': the code formats the limit with N0 in the process culture, so a non-Vietnamese server locale renders '300,000'.

cases.note: UC-60 · MSG402 · Deviation: Deviation: failure=Invalid (Invalid holds, MSG402 holds, nothing saved), but errors.content is 'Nhập nội dung biên bản, tối đa 300,000 ký tự.' not the UTC-quoted '…tối đa 300.000 ký tự.': N0 formatting follows the process culture.
